intent_en: To compare the estimated sales volumes and legal status of medical versus recreational marijuana markets.
previous_intent: To compare the estimated sales volumes and regulatory factors (such as tax rates and legalization dates) between medical and recreational marijuana markets.
narration_support: medical marijuana, which has been legal since 2000 and whose tax rate is 78 % lower. Estimated pot sales are 55 tons of medical pot and 18 .4 tons of recreational pot.
chart_support: Bar chart comparing sales volume between Medical (55 tons) and Dispensary (18.4 tons) categories, with the Medical category labeled as established in 2000.
evidence_note: Narration provides specific sales figures and legal context (2000, tax rate). Chart visualizes the volume difference (Medical > Dispensary) and legal establishment date.
